evidence_cutoff.same_day_policy: Only sources verified as available on or before 2026-10-07 may be promoted; ambiguous same-day availability remains HOLD.
evidence_cutoff.rationale: Avoid fabricating an exact timestamp while freezing a reproducible date-bounded knowledge snapshot.

update_policy: Any post-cutoff source requires a new KnowledgeSnapshot revision and cannot silently rewrite the A2R snapshot.
